within_book.note: Pooled (B) corr is dominated by BETWEEN-book geometry (a tight corpus like color_image yields high coph AND high DP/ARI for all constructions). The fair, geometry-controlled test demeans each book (centers the 3 constructions) so only WHICH-algorithm signal remains.

join_B.ari_vs_recon_baseline_caveat: ARI@k lift over cl_<slug>_recon.json is NOT a pure algorithm win: the recon labels a DIFFERENT point set (the book gap_article_ids, not top-N-by-max-cosine) and cuts the PRODUCTION tree at n_our_clusters (5/5/10/17) not at k=n_chapters. The cleaner labeled set + matched-k cut account for much of the lift; treat it as directional, not attributable to the linkage method alone.
